comment: Native-only (iOS) strings; merged into strings.json by scripts/export-shared.mjs. Keys must not collide with i18n.js. conv.copyTitle, dates.btn and hours.cancel were retired from i18n.js in v1.2 and are kept here because the iOS app uses them. widget.intent.* are the App Intents titles, descriptions and parameter names of the widget extension (they must live in the default table). convertTip.* is the TipKit tip above the clock cards (tip.* belongs to i18n.js). plan.partial is the iPhone planner summary for a day with no full overlap (the Windows planner words its own line with plan.best from i18n.js), and plan.legend.best labels its dashed band in the legend.

en.search.noResultsSub: Try a city, a country, an abbreviation like EST or an offset like +3
en.settings.privacy: Works fully offline. No accounts, no tracking, no network access. Your cities stay on this device.
